SELECT machine_id,
       COUNT(*) AS total_readings,
       SUM(CASE WHEN heat_dissipation_failure = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS heat_dissipation_failures
FROM sf_plant.machine_telemetry
WHERE ts >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ts < DATE '2026-11-01'
GROUP BY machine_id
ORDER BY heat_dissipation_failures DESC, total_readings DESC
LIMIT 20
